player.name: Rajdeep Tarafder
player.title: Wellsite & Exploration Geologist
player.summary: High-impact Exploration & Wellsite Geologist at ONGC blending 2.5 years of frontier basin interpretation (Vindhyan Block Group) with frontline drilling rig operations. Proven record in 2D/3D seismic interpretation (Petrel, PaleoScan), prospect maturation across BExB and EPMB blocks, 3D Mechanical Earth Modeling (MEM), and pioneering national clean energy exploration in Natural Hydrogen (H2) and Helium (He). Experienced in real-time wellsite lithological logging, hydrocarbon surveillance (UV cut/fluorescence, C1-C5 chromatograph), pore pressure / PDA surveillance, and critical 8.5" phase open-ended drill pipe cement squeeze remediation at GDA-A Samastipur.

highlights: 24/7 real-time formation top evaluation and geological prognosis correlation on active exploratory drilling rigs.
Precision drill-cuttings lithological description under binocular microscope, grain texture analysis, and mineralogical identification.
Continuous hydrocarbon surveillance: direct fluorescence, chemical solvent cut evaluation, and real-time mud gas surveillance (Total Gas & C1–C5 chromatographic breakdown).
Pore pressure estimation, dc-exponent trendline monitoring, trip gas / connection gas surveillance, and Pressure While Drilling (PDA) tracking across 12hr and 24hr shift rotations.
Supervision of critical 8.5" phase drilling and open-ended drill pipe cement squeeze operations for wellbore integrity remediation at GDA-A Samastipur.

roles.period: Nov 2023 – Present (2.5 Years Total Track Record)
highlights: Spearheaded multi-vintage 2D and 3D seismic interpretation utilizing Petrel and PaleoScan, constructing high-resolution Relative Geologic Time (RGT) models and structural fault-seal frameworks.
Generated, evaluated, and successfully defended drillable exploratory prospects across BExB and EPMB exploration blocks before executive review management committees.
Pioneered unconventional clean resource exploration targeting Natural Hydrogen (H2) and Helium (He) play concepts in deep basement shear systems across Vindhyan & Chhattisgarh basins.
Conducted critical mineral enrichment zone mapping and 3D Mechanical Earth Modeling (MEM) / fault mapping in Son Valley & Bhima-Kaladgi basins.
Performed integrated petrophysical wireline log evaluations (DSPetrophysics) for sandstone and carbonate reservoirs.
Monitored under-drilling exploratory wells, executed Pore Pressure & Drillability Analysis (PDA), and managed technical administration and statutory directorate reporting.
Analyzed upstream E&P operations across the Assam Shelf Basin; evaluated source rock maturation, Barail and Tipam sandstone reservoirs, regional seals, and structural traps.
Interpreted open-hole wireline logs (Gamma Ray, Deep/Shallow Resistivity, RHOB-NPHI, Sonic) to identify lithology, permeable intervals, and hydrocarbon-water contacts.
Observed on-site drilling protocols, mud logging operations, cuttings sample preparation, and drill-stem formation pressure testing.
Practical open-cast mine training at Dalli-Rajhara Iron Ore Complex (captive mines of Bhilai Steel Plant); mapped open-cast mine benches and structural contacts.
Estimated iron ore reserves using the geological cross-section method; correlated bench profiles with exploratory borehole lithologs.
Conducted petrographic and chemical characterization of Banded Iron Formations (BIF, BHQ) and high-grade hematite deposits; evaluated mineral beneficiation circuits.

researchTheses.title: Host Rock Identification & Provenance Detection via Machine Learning
researchTheses.description: Engineered supervised machine learning pipelines (Random Forest, SVM, Decision Trees, Logistic Regression) to predict parent host-rock lithologies and tectonic provenance from garnet EPMA geochemical datasets. Overcame classical thermo-barometric limitations where bulk-rock context is absent in detrital records. Established discriminative geochemical vectors directly applicable to diamond exploration (identifying mantle-derived kimberlitic pyrope garnets) and metamorphic terrane mapping.

researchTheses.title: Exchange of Iron from Atmosphere to Ocean Under Anthropogenic Inducements
researchTheses.description: Investigated global atmospheric iron (Fe) emissions from fossil fuel combustion and biomass burning. Evaluated atmospheric transport pathways, chemical/mineralogical controls on fractional aerosol Fe solubility, and nutrient bioavailability for marine phytoplankton in High-Nutrient Low-Chlorophyll (HNLC) ocean basins, quantifying feedback loops into the global carbon cycle.

fieldwork.title: Sedimentary Terrain & Modern Coastal Facies
fieldwork.mentors: Dr. Anupam Ghosh & Dr. Soumik Samanta
fieldwork.highlights: Conducted high-resolution coastal and estuarine sedimentary facies mapping. Documented planar/trough cross-stratification, flaser/lenticular bedding, and verified Walther's Law through vertical stratigraphic logs and modern ichnological trace fossil distributions.

fieldwork.title: Metamorphic Terrain & Polyphase Structural Analysis
fieldwork.mentors: Dr. Pulak Sengupta & Dr. Subrata Karmakar
fieldwork.highlights: Mapped high-grade Precambrian metamorphic and basement crystalline rocks. Measured foliation, lineation, shear indicators, and fold axial planes to unravel polyphase tectonometamorphic deformation stages (D1–D3).

fieldwork.title: Introductory Geological Field Mapping
fieldwork.mentors: Dr. Susanta Choudhary & Dr. Supriyo Mondal
fieldwork.highlights: Mastered Brunton compass & clinometer structural measurement techniques, topographic navigation, base map creation, and litho-stratigraphic identification in hand specimen.
